Marta (CS): Heads-up — prepping a quick spend handoff for Spend Scout before Friday's account review. Need a succinct runway + alert summary.
Alex (AE): Thanks — client asked for 'what's the risk this month' number. can we get an expected overrun %?
Sanju (Fin): I ran a quick pass — looks like a ~12% over baseline if current embed-heavy flows continue. pulling exact breakdown now.
Evan (Eng): FYI infra saw 3x embed QPS spike during last deploy window, might be skewing forecast. I'll add a note.
Marta (CS): Great — can you drop a one-liner we can paste in the QBR deck?
Evan (Eng): Sure: "Transient embed spike after rollout increased token consumption ~3x for 18h; we recommend temporary throttles + cache hints to avoid recurrence."
Priya (Enablement): I'll prep a short enablement note for the CSM to share with the customer's SRE: sample cache headers, batch size suggestion, and a one-paragraph on quantization tradeoffs.
Sanju (Fin): Numbers snapshot: current month forecast = 138k usd, committed baseline = 123k usd, delta = 15k (12.2%). Alerts triggered at 10% and 20% thresholds.
billing-bot: ALERT: account spend crossed 10% threshold at 2025-03-12T14:08:21Z — current run rate projecting +12% month-over-month.
Alex (AE): Can we call out top 3 call patterns causing most tokens? (chat-system, batch-embeds, rerank)
Evan (Eng): Top contributors from telemetry: batch-embeds (46%), chat-system prompts (31%), rerank jobs (12%). Rest misc.
Marta (CS): Action items: 1) Sanju finalize 1-slide cost delta + recommended credits ask 2) Priya draft enablement snippet 3) Alex to own the customer-facing message 4) Evan to add ops note on transient spike. Who owns the deck slide?
Alex (AE): I'll own the slide. deadline EOD Thursday.
Sanju (Fin): I'll paste the 1-line numbers into a csv and attach to the thread by EOD.
Priya (Enablement): I'll post the enablement blurb and code snippet for cache headers in the channel by noon.
Marta (CS): Perfect. Also, quick suggestion for QBR: add a 'what we did since last QBR' bullet on the autoscaling change and the new prefix cache — good signal.
Alex (AE): noted. We'll frame the mitigation plan + short-term credits ask.
Evan (Eng): one more: if they want immediate relief, we can propose a 2-week burst cap increase on Dedicated while we tune batch sizing.
Marta (CS): Thanks team. I'll start the slide draft with these bullets and ping once Sanju/ Priya paste the artifacts. :thumbsup:
Sanju (Fin): Uploaded csv: `spend_snapshot_1765554322.csv` — includes per-route token counts and projected delta.
Priya (Enablement): Uploaded snippet: `cache_hints.md` with examples and sample curl.
Alex (AE): cool — pulling into deck, will circulate for review before EOD.
Marta (CS): Closing loop — if anyone sees spend >20% before Friday, call it out here and we'll trigger the exec escalation play.
billing-bot: NOTE: Next automated checkpoint in 4h.
